perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

enhanced.name: High-Impact Reserves
enhanced.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage. Improved damage starts earlier in the magazine.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.description: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

enhanced.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
enhanced.description: Rapidly improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

enhanced.name: Rewind Rounds
enhanced.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it more effectively refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

enhanced.name: Hip-Fire Grip
enhanced.description: Greatly increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.description: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Loose Change
enhanced.description: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for an improved duration.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.description:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

enhanced.name: Jolting Feedback
enhanced.description:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt at an increased rate. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

enhanced.name: Desperate Measures
enhanced.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.description: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

enhanced.name: Killing Tally
enhanced.description: Final blows increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded. Improves magazine size.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.description: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

enhanced.name: Target Lock
enhanced.description: Damage increases by an improved amount the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

enhanced.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
enhanced.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine. Increases time between precision shots.

perks.name: Detonator Beam
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target.

enhanced.name: Detonator Beam
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target. Triggers faster.
